titleEnglish: Tu Kuja Man Kuja — Hafiz Ibrahim Aadhil

verses.ar:
Tu Kuja Man Kuja
Tu Kuja Man Kuja
Mine is a lowly station
And yours exalted beyond imagination
verses.en:
Where are you — where am I?
Where are you — where am I?
Mine is a lowly station
And yours exalted beyond imagination

verses.ar:
Tu Ameere Haram Main Faqeere Ajam
Tere Gun Aur Ye Lab Main Talab Hi Talab
verses.en:
You are commander of the holy sanctuary, and I a poor foreigner
I am but a humble seeker, my sinful lips unworthy to sing your lofty praises

verses.ar:
Tu Ata Hi Ata
Ilham Hai Jama Tera
Qur'an Imaama Hai Tera
Mimbar Tera Arshe Bari
Ya Rehmatullil Aalameen
verses.en:
You are the everlasting blessing
You are gloriously adorned in the robe of divine revelation
The Quran forms your exalted turban
The highest heaven is your mimbar
O Mercy for the Worlds

verses.ar:
Tu Kuja Man Kuja
Tu Kuja Man Kuja
Tu Kuja Man Kuja
verses.en:
Where are you — where am I?
Mine is a lowly station
And yours exalted beyond imagination

verses.ar:
Mera Har Saans To Khoon Nichoray Mera
Teri Rehmat Mager Dil Na Toray Mera
Qasa-e-zaat Hu Teri Khairat Hu
Tu Sakhee Mai Gada
Tu Haqeeqat Hai Main Sirf Ahsaas Hu
Tu Samandar Main Bhatkti Hui Pyaas Hu
Mera Ghar Khaak Par Aur Teri Reh Guzar
verses.en:
With every breath I take a step towards death
Yet I fail to accept your blessings (to absolve myself)
For I am a wretched being incomparable to your glory
You are the generous forgiving one while I am the beggar
You are reality, I merely perception
You are the ocean, I a wandering thirst
My dwelling is on the humble soil, and you journey beyond even the 7th heaven to Sidratul Muntaha

verses.ar:
Khusbu Teri Ju-e-Karam
Aankhein Teri Baab-e-Haram
Noor-e-Azal Teri Jabeen
Ya Rehmat-al-lil-alameen
verses.en:
Your scent is the bringer of blessings
Your eyes are the doors to the Haram sharif
Your forehead shines with the eternal noor
O Mercy to all the worlds

verses.ar:
Jagmagao Jo Halaat Ke Samnay
Aye Tera Tasavur Mujhay Thaamnay
Meri Khush Qismati Mai Tera Ummati
Tu Jaza Mai Raza
verses.en:
When I panic against the trials of life
I am calmed by thinking of you
It is my fortune that I am your follower
You are the reward, I am the wish

verses.ar:
Khairul Bashar Rutba Tera
Aawaaze Haq Khutba Tera
Aafaaq Tere Saame'een
Saais Gibreele Ameen
Ya Rehmatullil Aalameen
verses.en:
You are the best of mankind
Your sermons are the voice of haq
The heavens are your audience
Jibril the trustworthy is your horse keeper
O Mercy to all the Worlds

verses.ar:
Nisbat Teri Imaan Hay
Khusboo Teri Irfan hay
Tafseer Tere Khulq ki Quran Hi Quran Hay
Tu Hasil-e-Dunya O Deen
Ya Rehmat-al-lil-alameen
verses.en:
To be your follower is the testament of faith
Your scent is the scent of wisdom
Your glory is explained by the Quran itself
You are the gain of the world and religion
O Mercy to all the worlds

verses.ar:
Tu Hai Ahraame Anwaar Baandhe Hue
Main Duroodo Ki Dastaar Baandhe Hue
Kaaba E Ishq Tu Main Tere Chaar Soo
Tu Asar Main Dua
verses.en:
You are covered in the garment of illumination and splendour
And I wear the humble turban cloth of salutations of you
You are the Kaaba of love and I make tawaf around you
I am the dua and you its answer

verses.ar:
Dawa Hay Teri Chah Ka, Is Ummat-e-Gumrah Ka
Tere Siwa Koi Nahin
Ya Rehmat-al-lil-alameen
Dooryan Samney Say Jo Hatnay Lagein
Jaaliyon Say Nigahen Lipatney Lagein
Aansuon Ki Zuban Ho Meri Tarjuman
Dil Se Niklay Sada
verses.en:
This lost nation claims to be your follower
There is none besides you that can guide them
O Mercy to all the worlds
Now the vast distances are getting short
And my eyes can see your blessed tomb
Let my tears speak for me
From the depths of my heart I say
